Process

A guided path from first brief to finished launch.

The workflow keeps strategy, content, design, assets, and implementation connected instead of scattering decisions across disconnected handoffs.

Map the customer journey

Define lifecycle stages, owners, required fields, handoffs, service types, and decision points.

Configure the workspace

Shape pipelines, views, permissions, automations, dashboards, and forms around real team behavior.

Migrate and clean data

Normalize records, remove duplicates, confirm fields, and prepare imports before teams rely on reporting.

Train by role

Give sales, service, leadership, and admin users clear examples for their actual daily workflows.

Review and optimize

Use usage patterns, stuck records, missed follow-ups, and reporting gaps to refine the CRM over time.
